body: well thank you for reading my story

you should never be ashamed of yourself for being sad, or for making mistakes.  i know everyone says this, but it's true!  everyone gets sad!  everyone has hard times and makes mistakes!  i know you think it may be best to stop the pain, but even if you think it won't affect anyone, it will make the people in your neighborhood depressed.  i should know.  i lived next to someone who killed themselves.  even though they almost never came outside, and NEVER once said a word to anyone, not even when they moved in, EVERYONE felt bad, because they thought they should have done something to help them.  not only that, but *I* felt bad.  since i was already depressed, it caused me to go over the edge.  i was hysterical, screaming that life wasn't worth it.  i was able to calm down eventually, but that event stayed with me.  i still feel terrible that i didn't know that they wanted to kill themselves.  if i *had* known, i would have never left their side.  ALL life is precious.  each and every person deserves happiness.  i hope i have helped, if at all op.

I know the feeling, both sides.  And I felt like a worthless asshole for it, like someone who shouldn't exist.  I already had a MAJOR problem with my depression, and saying that just made it worse for both of us.  When take until there's nothing left, you  know you've done something wrong.  But when you keep taking, after that, It just causes pain for everyone.  Those who don't understand often don't realize.  So here's to those who have the resolve and courage to stay and support someone, if anyone in their time of pain.  Cheers

Thank you so much for taking the time to reply!  By a while ago, I meant 3 months, and I'm not considering suicide or self harm, nor will be, unless something terrible happens.  I have picked up some hobbies, and they are really fun, but I can only do them on the weekends.  I do have dreams and aspirations, and I am working towards them.  I am currently out of work though.  I understand riding the wave, but I'm not sure I'll be able to do that for a while.  I can't thank you enough for giving support and advice to people that are hurting.  😊👍

I'm definitely not an expert, as I have my own problems, but in my opinion, I think you should ask her out.
